Credit-claiming is when a senator claims personal responsibility or takes credit for a federal benefit, program, funding, or action that benefits their constituents or state. 1. **57** - Kennedy introducing legislation on stem cell research. This is a policy statement/position-taking (introducing legislation), not claiming credit for delivering benefits. Introduction of legislation is position-taking. Hmm, but "introduced legislation" is more of a legislative action. Credit-claiming in Mayhew's sense is claiming responsibility for particularized benefits. Introducing a bill isn't delivering benefits yet. I'd say 0 - this is position-taking on policy.
